evals.prompt: Küçük bir stok takip API'si yaz: ürünler (ad, sku, adet, fiyat) için CRUD. SQLite kullan, modül github.com/kadir/stok, proje ./stok dizinine.
evals.expected_output: Derlenen, katmanlı (handler/service/repository/domain) Go projesi; .env tabanlı config; gömülü migration; Makefile.
assertions: go build ./... passes
go vet ./... passes
Layered packages exist: internal/handler, internal/service, internal/repository, internal/domain
SQL statements appear only under internal/repository (no 'database/sql' or SQL text in handler/service)
No net/http usage inside internal/service or internal/repository
Config is read from .env + prefixed env vars via internal/config (no os.Getenv outside internal/config)
Migrations are .sql files under internal/repository/migrations and are embedded (go:embed)
Makefile exists with build and release (cross-compile) targets
Comments are in Turkish, identifiers in English
Uses a pure-Go SQLite driver (modernc.org/sqlite), not CGO mattn/go-sqlite3
Products table has name, sku, quantity, price columns and full CRUD endpoints (list/get/create/update/delete)
Unique SKU conflict handled via repository.IsUniqueViolation (no driver-specific error type import, no pgconn)

evals.prompt: Bu projeye tedarikçi (supplier) tablosu ve endpoint'leri ekle: ad, e-posta, telefon. Listeleme ve ekleme yeterli.
evals.expected_output: Yeni migration + domain + repository + service + handler dosyaları, kayıtlar yapılmış, proje derleniyor.
assertions: go build ./... passes
go vet ./... passes
New migration file 0002_*.sql added under internal/repository/migrations/postgres (0001 unchanged)
New files internal/domain/supplier.go, internal/repository/supplier.go, internal/service/supplier.go, internal/handler/supplier.go
SupplierRepo registered in repository/repos.go and Suppliers service registered in service/service.go
Routes for GET and POST /api/v1/suppliers registered in handler/server.go routes()
Repository queries use ? placeholders passed through db.Rebind
Email validated in domain Input.Validate() and returns ValidationError (400)
Existing scaffold conventions preserved (no new router/ORM/config dependency added)

evals.prompt: Postgres kullanan bir kısa link servisi yaz, ./kisalt dizinine, modül github.com/kadir/kisalt. POST /links kısa kod üretsin, GET /{code} yönlendirsin, tıklama sayısı tutulsun.
evals.expected_output: Derlenen katmanlı Go projesi; postgres:// DATABASE_URL; redirect handler; tıklama sayacı repository'de.
assertions: go build ./... passes
go vet ./... passes
Layered packages exist: internal/handler, internal/service, internal/repository, internal/domain
SQL statements appear only under internal/repository (no 'database/sql' or SQL text in handler/service)
No net/http usage inside internal/service or internal/repository
Config is read from .env + prefixed env vars via internal/config (no os.Getenv outside internal/config)
Migrations are .sql files under internal/repository/migrations and are embedded (go:embed)
Makefile exists with build and release (cross-compile) targets
Comments are in Turkish, identifiers in English
DATABASE_URL uses postgres:// scheme and pgx driver
GET /{code} returns an HTTP redirect (301/302/307) and increments click count in repository
POST /links generates a unique short code and returns it as JSON
Duplicate short code handled via repository.IsUniqueViolation (no pgconn import)
No test-only SQLite driver or migrations/sqlite directory added to the Postgres project
